title: The Friend Who Never Agreed
subtitle: 友谊关系 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 友谊关系（社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）
meta: 主题语境：友谊关系（社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）　|　核心词汇：mind　|　正文 357 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 mind 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: I had a friend at university with whom I agreed about almost nothing, and who was nevertheless the person I ① minded least in a room of forty. That is not a contradiction. A ② mind that agrees with you is company; one that does not is a tool, and I needed a tool more than I needed company.

His name was Joseph and he had a habit of changing the subject two minutes before I finished, which I found unbearable and which, I now see, was the whole point. He did not ③ mind being disliked; he minded being agreed with. In the ④ mind of most people that is rudeness. In his it was a form of politeness, because it meant he had been listening.

We fell out once, properly, over something neither of us can now remember. What I remember is that neither of us would ⑤ mind the gap: for four months we ⑥ minded our own business in the same building and passed each other like furniture. Then he wrote me a letter — a letter, in 2004 — in which he said he had been wrong about one thing and right about another, and would I ⑦ mind meeting for a coffee.

I ⑧ made up my mind to say no, and said yes, and we met, and he was exactly as tiresome as before. What he had, which I have valued ever since, was a mind that was not trying to be liked, and he would ⑨ change his mind in private, which is a far rarer thing. Friendship, I have decided, is not the same as being agreed with; and the person who tells you that you are wrong, in private, and often, is the person who has decided you are worth the trouble.

Mind, he would have said, is not the same as memory. He died in 2019. I have kept the letter. There is one ⑩ mind I have never been able to replace, and I have stopped trying to; what I do instead is the thing he did for me, which is to say the unpopular thing early, before it is too late to be useful.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 头脑；心智；思维方式
B. n. 有才智的人；有头脑的人
C. v. 介意；在乎（mind sth/doing）
D. v. 照看；留意（mind the shop/gap）
E. 固定搭配：mind one's own business 少管闲事
F. 固定搭配：make up one's mind 下定决心
G. 固定搭配：change one's mind 改变主意
H. 固定搭配：in the mind of 在……看来；在……心目中

items.q: the person I minded least in a room of forty
A mind that agrees with you is company
He did not mind being disliked
In the mind of most people that is rudeness
neither of us would mind the gap
we minded our own business in the same building
would I mind meeting for a coffee
I made up my mind to say no
he would change his mind in private
There is one mind I have never been able to replace

answers.why: mind 作动词，意为“介意、在乎”，此处反说：四十人的屋里我最不介意的就是他。
指“思维方式、头脑”，说一个总附和你的头脑只是陪伴。
动词，意为“介意”，说他不在乎被人讨厌，在乎的是被附和。
in the mind of 意为“在……看来、在……心目中”，说多数人认为那是粗鲁。
mind the gap 意为“留意（彼此间的）空隙”，此处双关：谁也不肯先修补那道裂缝。
mind one's own business 意为“只管自己的事”，说四个月里两人各不相干。
动词，would you mind doing 意为“你介意……吗”，用于约咖啡。
make up one's mind 意为“下定决心”，说我本决心拒绝却答应了。
change one's mind 意为“改变主意”，说他只在私下改变想法，这更难得。
mind 指“有才智的人”，说这样的一个人我再也找不到替代。
